blocks.text: The rulers’ fear of being “put out of the synagogue” has sometimes been used to reconstruct stages in the relationship between Johannine believers and synagogues. The wording supports historical investigation, but it does not by itself establish a single late-first-century decree or a uniform rupture between synagogue and church. Likewise, when Jesus says that being “lifted up” will draw “all” or “all people” to himself, the narrative explicitly connects the lifting up with his death, while the scope of “all” remains disputed: interpreters propose universal, representative, and judgment-focused readings. None of these readings warrants coercion.
